name: cad-bench-neurips-2026-anonymous-dataset
description: Anonymous reviewer dataset for CAD-bench. It contains 17 executable CAD task payloads: natural-language prompts, TOML metadata, expected values, reference Build123D programs, task fixtures, and a manifest with per-task bundle hashes.
citation: Anonymous Author(s). CAD-bench: An Executable Benchmark for Language-Model CAD Agents. 2026.
citeAs: Anonymous Author(s). CAD-bench anonymous task dataset. 2026.

distribution.name: tasks_manifest.json
distribution.description: Task manifest with one record per task and SHA-256 hashes for files in each task bundle.

distribution.name: task_directories
distribution.description: All per-task payload directories under tasks/<task_id>/.

distribution.name: task_metadata_files
distribution.description: Task metadata, difficulty, evaluator name, and expected values.

distribution.name: task_prompt_files
distribution.description: Natural-language task prompts shown to evaluated systems.

distribution.name: task_reference_programs
distribution.description: Reference Build123D programs used for validation, evaluator calibration, and media generation.

distribution.name: task_fixtures
distribution.description: Optional task fixtures, including the third-party STEP fixture for the M3 socket-head screw task.

recordSet.name: tasks
recordSet.description: One record per CAD-bench task directory, enumerated by tasks_manifest.json and resolved by the CAD-bench runtime from the code artifact.

rai:dataCollection: Tasks were authored as synthetic CAD prompts and benchmark metadata. The dataset does not contain human-subject records or scraped personal data. The M3 socket-head screw task includes a McMaster-Carr STEP fixture for part 91290A111, governed by McMaster-Carr website and CAD download terms.
rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for evaluating language-model CAD agents and CAD code-generation systems through the CAD-bench runtime provided at the Code URL. It is not intended to certify generated mechanical designs as safe for manufacturing or deployment.
rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark has 17 tasks and emphasizes Build123D-compatible reference implementations in the current release. Some tasks are close to solved, while functional assembly tasks remain difficult. Scores should be interpreted as diagnostic signals rather than broad CAD competence guarantees.
rai:dataBiases: The task distribution reflects authored mechanical CAD prompts and overrepresents programmatic Build123D-style construction, metric units, and small mechanical parts relative to the full range of CAD work. It underrepresents large industrial assemblies, GUI-native CAD workflows, non-mechanical CAD domains, and non-metric conventions.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included in the task records.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive uses include more transparent evaluation of CAD assistants, engineering education, and lower-friction prototyping. Misuse risks include overtrust in generated mechanical designs and faster iteration on unsafe or restricted hardware. The benchmark should not be used as a safety certification tool.
